basic_details.job_title: RGCB Project Research Scientist I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

age_limit.details: Below 35 years on 14th October 2026. Age relaxation will be given as per Govt. of India norms.

qualification.details: Minimum of one year of experience in handling Biophysical techniques.

salary_details.details: The position is funded by the ICMR/MAHA MedTech project titled "An AI-Integrated Ultrasensitive Nanopore Sensing System for Non-invasive Early Detection of Cervical Cancer" under the Laboratory of Dr. Mahandran K R, Scientist E-II at Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology (BRIC-RGCB), Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.

selection_process: Applications are shortlisted based on the eligibility criteria. Selection of suitable candidates will be made based on qualifications and performance in the selection interview.
how_to_apply: Ensure you meet all eligibility criteria for the position.
Access the online application portal via the official website.
Ensure applications are submitted through proper channels if currently working in Government firms.
Submit separate application forms if wishing to apply for different positions.
important_instructions: Applications should be submitted online. Candidates currently working in Government firms must send applications through proper channel. Last date for receiving completed applications is 14 October 2026. Separate application forms must be submitted if applying for different positions. Selection to the position will not entitle the candidate to any future positions at RGCB (permanent or otherwise), and the position will be coterminus with the end of the project. Applications which are not in the prescribed format will summarily be rejected. Only those fulfilling the above criteria need apply, as applicants will be shortlisted for the online selection interview based on eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q1. What is RGCB Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a project-based recruitment notification issued by the Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology for 1 Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) post under an ICMR/MAHA MedTech funded project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving completed applications is 14 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What educational qualification is required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M.Sc or equivalent degree in any branch of Life Sciences with 70% marks, plus a minimum of one year of experience in Membrane Protein Purification with a documented experience certificate.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit to apply?
faq.answer: Applicants must be below 35 years of age on 14th October 2026, with age relaxation given as per Govt. of India norms.
